ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Wa la-sawfa yar-da' in Surah Al-Layl?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse (91:18) is often interpreted as the culmination of the spiritual journey, where divine pleasure (Rida) signifies the ultimate reward for those who purify their souls through charity and mindfulness. It highlights the reciprocal nature of the covenant: just as the righteous strive for God's pleasure, God grants them a state of ease and satisfaction in the Hereafter, affirming the efficacy of their spiritual efforts.
